Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting wholesale sales of bulk unprocessed milk from the business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting wholesale sales of unprocessed milkfor processing from business and occupation tax; and amending RCW82.04.332.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.332 and 1998 c 312 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received from buyingunprocessed milk, wheat, oats, dry peas, dry beans, lentils, triticale,canola, corn, rye, and barley, but not including any manufacturedproducts thereof, and selling the same at wholesale.
